resources.string: Startup uses saved lists. Choose manual or periodic updates in Settings > Radio > Subscription refresh. Close this window to keep using the app during an update.

Manual by default. Automatic updates wait until the player is ready and you have used the app in the foreground for at least one minute. Never during startup, at boot or in the background. Only overdue, enabled lists are downloaded. Failed or cancelled automatic attempts wait for the next interval; Update still works anytime. Playback connection and buffering are separate.

Managing subscriptions
Add trusted radio-only TXT/M3U playlist URLs. Each subscription keeps a separate last-good list. Enable, disable, edit, remove or update one list independently. Matching names or stream URLs share a station; different addresses become playing sources. Local stations are not deleted by subscription updates.

Manual or periodic updates
Manual is the default. Add and update, Update and Update all remain available anytime, one download at a time. Settings > Radio > Subscription refresh also offers Monthly (30 days), Weekly (7 days) and Daily (24 hours). Automatic updates wait until the player is ready and the app has stayed in the foreground for at least one minute. They never run during startup, at boot or while the app is in the background. Only overdue, enabled lists are downloaded; failures and cancelled attempts wait for the next interval rather than retrying on each launch. Backgrounding the app or choosing Manual cancels an automatic update; last-good caches are retained.

Playback stays independent
You can close the subscription window and keep using the app. Updates do not test every stream or download logos. A current broadcast keeps its connection even if removed from a refreshed list; select a station again to use new addresses. Starting playback still needs a stream connection and buffering; CNR also obtains an expiring playback URL. These are not subscription-list refreshes.

Subscription limits and trusted sources
Up to 10 subscriptions, 1 MiB per download and 5,000 cached source entries in total. HTTP lists and audio are unencrypted. Only use publishers you trust; availability and regional restrictions vary.
No subscriptions yet. Choose a preset or add your own playlist URL.

Changing the URL keeps the last-good list until Update succeeds. This form does not change individual station addresses. Use a playlist URL, not an HLS audio manifest or a webpage. The Hacks Tools FM page address is converted to its published download URL.
Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters without line breaks.
Update cancelled. Completed updates and previous cached lists are kept.
Remove %1$s and its cached list? Manual stations, other subscriptions and the current broadcast are kept. Channels supplied only by this list disappear from selection.
Subscription saved. Cached lists are used without a startup download.
Subscription removed. Other station sources are kept.
This subscription changed while the operation was running. Open it again and retry.
This playlist URL is already subscribed. Edit or update the existing subscription.
Up to 10 subscriptions are supported. Remove one before adding another.
No enabled subscriptions to update. Add or enable a list first.
Subscriptions: %1$d updated, %2$d unchanged, %3$d failed. Unavailable entries: %4$d. Details are in Radio subscriptions.
%1$d entries have blank addresses or unsupported stream protocols and are not selectable.
%1$d invalid logo addresses ignored; station audio is kept.
Network connection failed or timed out. Try Update again.
The download is empty, invalid UTF-8, incomplete, a webpage or an HLS manifest, rather than a valid station list.
The download or combined catalog exceeds the limits: 1 MiB per download, 5,000 cached subscription sources, 5,000 visible stations and 32 sources per station. No partial list is applied.
An HTTPS playlist redirected to an insecure address. The update was rejected.

Fanmingming public radio-only M3U, including CNR and regional stations. Blank addresses and unsupported protocols such as RTMP are reported and omitted. Invalid logos are ignored without dropping valid audio. Some old URLs may not play. No station audio or logos are downloaded when adding this list.

72FM publishes a weekly playlist of up to 300 community-voted stations from Radio Browser public-domain directory data. These are third-party lists, not broadcaster endorsements. Some streams may be unavailable in your region.
A weekly top-500 playlist ranked by Radio Browser community votes, with country groups. This overlaps the US and UK lists; matching stations and addresses are combined rather than duplicated.

CCTV-1–17, CCTV-5+ and CCTV-4 Europe/Americas audio feeds from the community-maintained Kimentanm / aptv list. This preset keeps only CCTV audio CDN addresses and places them under CCTV Television. Other entries and remote logos are excluded. These are television soundtracks, not separate FM stations. No video, background refresh or startup stream checks. Availability and broadcast rights vary by region.
Replace all also disables subscriptions, keeping their URLs and caches so they can be enabled again explicitly. Otherwise a subscription could immediately put removed channels back.
This station is no longer in the enabled lists. Its current broadcast continues until you stop it or choose another station.
